purpose: Pin the minimum practical runtime lane for public trace capture without pretending this capsule has installed it.

python.source: Transformers installation docs tested on Python 3.10+

torch.reason: current Transformers docs state PyTorch 2.4+ tested; installed torch is probed by public_trace_env_preflight.py

transformers.current_docs_lineage: v5.x exists in 2026; adapter must pass transformers_llama_surface_probe.py rather than assuming internal compatibility

risk_note: Do not upgrade/downgrade Transformers blindly. The readiness gate checks the Llama eager-attention surface and exact snapshot before capture.

backend_identity.rule: If ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION is not eager, the public trace capture must abort. SDPA/Flash/Flex are timing/baseline lanes after trace acceptance, not the trace extraction hook.
